thread:
Mia: Quick heads-up — Cardinal Surface is ready to participate in a customer story tied to our benchmark webinar. Need to lock interview, quote approval timeline, and an embargo window. Draft here: https://docs.google.com/cardinal-case-draft (please request access if you can't open)

Sam: I can do the customer intro. Who owns running the interview and capturing the soundbites?

Oliver: I can run it. Prefer a 30-min recorded session + a short follow-up for clarifications. Tue/Thu next week looks best for me. Recording OK? :record_button:

Mia: Recording is fine. We need a clear quote approval flow so Legal can sign off before publish. Jess will own legal review.

Jess: Add me to the doc and highlight the exact quote lines. Legal needs three things: data-use consent, embargo end date, and whether we can publish any performance metrics. Also: mask any raw logs/PII. Email for formal signoff: legal@redwood.com

Oliver: I added proposed slots in the doc and pasted a short interview guide. Also flagging we want a 2-sentence latency/cost soundbite + one operational quote. Sam, can you prep the ops contact so we can get clean numbers?

Sam: Looping in Lila from Ops (lila.ops) to the doc. She'll supply verified numbers and a quick table.

Mia: Embargo/launch plan check: product launch = 2024-11-12. Legal wants final quote text by 2024-11-05 to review. Marketing needs final approved quote by 2024-11-07 to prep blog, social, and webinar assets.

Oliver: Aiming to complete the interview and first-pass transcript edits by 2024-11-01. Will call out any obviously sensitive lines for redaction.

Jess: Note — redact or anonymize customer-identifying metadata in the transcript. If the customer requests redlines, they must be returned within 48 hours for us to hit the launch calendar.

Mia: Lead routing note: after publish, inbound leads from this case need to go to AE queue "CS-Enterprise" and be tagged `case:cardinal-surface`. Sam, can you confirm webhook / routing?

Sam: Confirmed. We'll push to /sfdc/leads with source=case_cardinal_surface and add HubSpot nurture flow. Also setting lead priority = medium-high for demo follow-ups.

Oliver: One ask for the customer — are they open to a 3-4 minute demo clip during the webinar? If yes, we need an NDA addendum for the demo footage.

Mia: I'll ask Cardinal about the demo and NDA today. If they agree, legal will need the demo script and assets 7 days before the webinar for clearance. :calendar: :thumbsup:

casebot: Created checklist and working doc: https://redwood.intranet/docs/CS-2024-091-cardinal-surface-checklist — workflow id #CS-2024-091

Jess: If you add the final quote lines today, I can do an initial pass by 2024-10-30. If there are redlines, please ping me directly so I can triage.

Mia: Thanks team — keeping this thread as the single source of truth for the timeline. Oliver, Sam please update the doc with confirmed interview slot and ops numbers. I will chase the NDA + demo ask with Cardinal. :eyes:
